You are hardening a billed-probe harness. Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. You may edit ONLY scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py and scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/test_live_baseline.py (and write under bench/results/transcript-1a-dry/). Never edit storygame/, data/, tests/, .plans/, git state or .env. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, use `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. Read both files first and match their style.

TWO DEFECTS TO FIX in live_baseline.py.
1. A quota response never reaches CallCounter.inspect: Cloudflare answers HTTP 429 with header X-Narration-Error-Code (AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED), and urllib raises urllib.error.HTTPError from urlopen before any response object is wrapped. In CallCounter.live_urlopen, catch urllib.error.HTTPError, inspect str(error.headers) and, when readable, the error body (read it once, then re-raise the SAME HTTPError with its body still readable, for example by re-creating it with io.BytesIO(body) as fp), so a quota code sets the stop and callers still see a normal HTTPError.
2. CallCapExceeded and QuotaExceeded are RuntimeError subclasses raised inside the provider's own request path, which may catch broad exceptions and turn them into a recovered turn, so the run would keep going. Add a sticky `stop_reason` attribute on CallCounter: set it when the cap would be exceeded (value MAX_CALLS_EXCEEDED) or a quota code is seen (value = the code), before raising. In _replicate, after EVERY engine.turn (and after engine.opening()), if counter.stop_reason is set, record the turn row you just built (so partial data is kept) and then raise the matching exception so main() stops all replicates and writes stopped_reason. Once stop_reason is set, before_call must keep raising so no further call is ever issued. Keep the existing behavior otherwise.

TESTS (test_live_baseline.py, keep the file small; add at most two tests): (a) a hermetic test that live_urlopen, given a fake urlopen raising HTTPError(429) with header X-Narration-Error-Code: AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, sets stop_reason to that code and re-raises an HTTPError whose body is still readable (monkeypatch urllib.request.urlopen; no network); (b) a test that when a swallowed CallCapExceeded happens inside a turn (monkeypatch the provider call path or use --max-calls 1 in dry mode, whichever is simplest), main() still ends with summary stopped_reason set and rows.json holding the partial turn, and the process returns 0. Existing three tests must still pass.

Finish: .venv/bin/python -m ruff format and ruff check on the two files, run all tests in scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/test_live_baseline.py, then run the full dry run: `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py --dry-run --replicates 2 --out bench/results/transcript-1a-dry` and `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/check_live_baseline.py bench/results/transcript-1a-dry 2 --mode dry`.
